profile.headline: Unreal Engine Developer / Software Engineer at AELIUS Exploitation Technologies, LLC
profile.summary: I make things with C++, Python, Unreal Engine, Jai, Zig and Win32/OpenGL/Vulkan. My approach to programming is data-oriented, balancing debugability and flexibility with cache performance. My primary focuses are video game engine programming, designing and coding video game AI, and making gui tools.

positions.title: AI Software Trainer - C++ / Video Game Engines (Contract)
positions.locationName: Mount Dora, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description: I decide freely what projects to give to an AI coding assistant, then steer and grade the AI over a long conversation with alignment comparisons and Reinforcement Learning scores.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- C++ and interop with blueprints.
- Collisions, pathfinding, environmental analysis and behavior for the 10k AI soldiers in the game.
- Multithreaded job system and thread safe data structures for the AI work.
- SIMD intrinsics employed for n x m distance comparisons.
- Compression of multiplayer data to allow for more updates per cycle, less network backtime on clients.
- Tools and automatic pipelines to facilitate the work of designers and artists.
- An AI that plays the game, used for automated performance testing.

positions.title: Programming and Machine Learning Instructor
positions.description:
Teach teenage students on:
• How to program in: python, C#, Unreal Visual Scripting
• How to make games in Unreal Engine and Unity
• Machine Learning and Statistics
Teach students to manage expectations.
Tailor project-based lessons to match student interests
Write post-session reports, tracking student progress.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Unreal Engine · Unity · Communication · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Academic Tutor
positions.description: Tutor undergraduate students in statistics: understanding mean and standard deviation, getting hypergeometric probabilities and, rarely, regression. Also tutor in Java, Python and C programming. Common themes of student projects are: basic input/output, using functions and methods and building class systems across multiple files.

positions.title: Programming Instructor
positions.description: Teach campers age 11-17 full time in various topics, including electrical engineering, computer science, programming and basic machine learning. One class built pi-top laptops, built circuits inside the bodies of the laptops and programmed the circuits to light up and play sounds. One student programmed a fun video game with a few buttons and an LED array. Another class programmed their own robot classes that were fed into a simple game I created, which allowed the students to watch their robots fight each other.
